Problem Description

Troubleshooting
:
For the Error Code 7:
"with v5.0.21 all software-based weld detections were removed and the original AUX feedback signal from the TDK contactor is used again to detect a stuck contactor. This also includes the false-positive cases, where the feedback signal itself is stuck"
“Recovery is performed 1 min later cooldown after the feedback is unstuck again”
Did these problems start occuring after the update to v5.0.21?
For
Gp2ivN:
For FTnJCz:
It seems like there is some problem connecting to the Operator.
I would recommend doing a firstboot and check afterwards. I performed this action in a single charger to see if it works.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0383703
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0383703-DC/Si-D/BE[Several] - OCPP offline CRM:00315001899
additional_info.body:
Hi Marnic,
i checked those 3 chargers and 2 of them are connected again to OCPP
1- On FTnJCz i found that the operator scan is somehow deactivated/buggy and its not working. Had to do some resets on linux and then it worked. Actually it looks normal but the SINR value is performing not so good somehow there is to much noise on this site
2- On 750nDv i found that the operator settings were set to a pool from greece why so ever. but now it should work fine.
Please observe those 2 chargers in the next days.
3- On Gp2ivN unfortunately something went wrong on the Update of the Router so i have to reset it via SSH to factory settings. Can be that it will work afterwards or it will go into failsafe
If its okay for you i will proceed on the router reset or do you wanna look into it on your own?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Semih
